_doc: Declarative backend binding for OT rv_timer. Reproduces the structurally-detected irq_blueprint (so the IRQ->PLIC path is byte-identical to BackendCharDevDetect) AND opts into the virtual-time PUMP. The pump is declared, not detected: 'this is a free-running timer that must keep time autonomously' is a SEMANTIC property not structurally inferable (e.g. i2c's timeout counters feed counter>=threshold comparators driving interrupts exactly like a timer, yet must NOT be pumped). See bindings/SCHEMA.md.
